shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln and Carrier Air Wing 9 entered Guam on the 19th local time, with the deployment having lasted 302 days and the carrier now in the final stage of returning to the U.S. West Coast.
